create_storage_client_s3: create a StorageClient with s3 protocol, storage root, base url, and s3 config for cloud storage
create_storage_client_file: create a StorageClient with file protocol, storage root, and base url for local filesystem storage
test_storage_client_exists: test the StorageClient exists method to check if a file path exists in the storage backend
get_storage_client_url: get a prepared URL for a storage path with a given revision using the StorageClient
delete_storage_dataset_directory: delete a dataset directory from storage using the StorageClient and return the number of directories deleted
